subject: Procurement readiness and timeline for Redwood (PO vs Card)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement readiness and timeline for Redwood (PO vs Card)

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can align with AcmeCloud's procurement process: 

1) Commercial path options:
   - Card (self-serve): fastest to get started for proof-of-concept; no PO required.
   - Purchase Order (PO): preferred for production expansion. We can accept Net 30 terms; Redwood legal has standard PO addendum.
   - Marketplace: you mentioned interest in GCP marketplace — we can provide marketplace SKU details, but there is typically an additional lead time for listing.

2) Typical procurement milestone map (what we've seen at similar customers):
   - Legal review (T+1 week for standard redlines)
   - Security review (SOC 2 + architecture review; T+1–2 weeks depending on questionnaire)
   - Finance approval (PO issuance, vendor onboarding; T+1 week after approvals)
   - PO submitted and signed / card on file -> provisioned access

3) Attachments I’m sending with this email:
   - Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf (MAP with owners & dates)
   - SOC2_Type2_redacted.pdf (summary, redacted)
   - SLA_T&Cs.pdf (standard terms & SLA)

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Can you confirm preferred commercial path (Card vs PO vs Marketplace)?
- If PO, who is the primary contact on your side for legal and finance?
- We’ll fill out your procurement intake form if you have one; otherwise we can send our vendor packet.

I’ve looped in Marcus (contracts) and Camila (deployment lead) so they can be available for the security/architecture review. If it helps, we can propose a mutual action plan with target dates — I attached a first draft.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf; SOC2_Type2_redacted.pdf; SLA_T&Cs.pdf

From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness and timeline for Redwood (PO vs Card)

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the materials. A few quick answers and notes from procurement at AcmeCloud: 

- Preferred path: PO for production. We may start on card for an initial pilot but our standard procurement for vendor relationships is PO.
- Our procurement lead is me (Elaine Wu) for the intake; legal review will be handled by our counsel (cc’d once things progress). Finance does vendor onboarding and will need W9 + vendor packet.
- Security: we’ll run Redwood’s SOC 2 and send a short questionnaire from our security team. If you have an engineer who can do a quick architecture walkthrough, that will expedite the review.

Tentative internal timeline (high level):
- Mar 24–26: Security questionnaire sent and initial review
- Mar 29–Apr 2: Legal review of contract/PO terms
- Apr 3–6: Finance onboarding and PO issuance

I’ll open a procurement ticket and share the intake form (if any) by end of day. For marketplace, we are exploring GCP Marketplace but that will add extra time and contracting nuances — ideally keep marketplace as a parallel track.

One ask: can Marcus or someone on the contracts team confirm Redwood’s standard lead time for contract signatures and whether you can accept standard AcmeCloud contract redlines (we typically redline indemnity and data protection language)?

Thanks,
Elaine
Procurement Lead | AcmeCloud
elaine.wu@acmecloud.com | (650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-24T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness and timeline for Redwood (PO vs Card)

Elaine —

Appreciate the clarity and the tentative timeline. Quick responses inline and proposed owners/dates for the MAP: 

- Commercial path: Noted — PO for production, card ok for pilot. We’ll treat PO as the primary path and card as fallback to shorten pilot start.
- Contracts lead: Marcus (cc) will handle legal redlines. Marcus — would you be able to confirm acceptance of AcmeCloud’s typical redlines around indemnity/data protection? If needed we can propose Redwood’s standard language which tends to be compatible with enterprise customers; estimated turnaround 3–5 business days for standard redlines.
- Security review: Camila (cc) can run a 30–45 min architecture/flows walkthrough with your security engineer. Proposed slots: Mar 25 10:00–11:00 PT or Mar 26 09:00–09:45 PT.
- Finance onboarding / PO: Once legal and security are green, finance typically issues PO within ~3 business days. Please share procurement intake form and vendor onboarding checklist when available.

I’ve updated the attached MAP with owners and the dates you suggested:
- Mar 25: Security questionnaire & architecture walkthrough (Camila owner)
- Mar 29–Apr 2: Legal review (Marcus owner)
- Apr 3–6: Finance onboarding & PO issuance (Elaine owner)

Next steps (action items):
- Elaine: share procurement intake form + vendor onboarding requirements (Elaine)
- Camila: confirm which slot works for the walkthrough and attendee list (Camila)
- Marcus: confirm redline cadence and lead time (Marcus)
- Marissa: will update MAP and push a Doc link after this thread (Marissa)

If that all sounds good I’ll schedule the walkthrough and share a HubSpot deal link with the MAP.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134

Attachment: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf
